reference:
Add these as secrets/variables in Railway dashboard:
- DATABASE_URL (required, get from Neon)
- GROQ_API_KEY (required, get from Groq console)
- CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME (required)
- CLOUDINARY_API_KEY (required)
- CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET (required)
- JWT_SECRET (required, generate with: python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(32))")
- CORS_ORIGINS (required, JSON format: ["https://your-vercel-url.vercel.app"])
